from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class InventoryData(BaseModel):
    company_name: str = Field(description="Name of the company in the financial report")
    inventory_value: float = Field(description="The numeric value of '存货' (inventory) reported in the document")
    currency: str = Field(description="The currency unit associated with the inventory value")
    reporting_period: str = Field(description="The reporting period for the financial data")
    statement_type: str = Field(description="The specific financial statement section where inventory is listed")
    text_quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim snippet containing the inventory value and amount")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    inventory_records: list[InventoryData]
